title: AI Expansion, Optimizations, & UX Polish Update
changes: Integrated AI Co-Pilot into the Personal Dashboard for natural language task creation and board querying
Added OCR Task Import to the Personal Dashboard for converting images and scanned documents into task lists
Introduced AI Generative Board creation to the Personal Sidebar and Business Sidebar
Refined List Assignee UI with sleek stacked name tags and improved workload readability
Polished the Generative Task UI by adjusting font dimensions and removing visual clutter
Improved Dashboard Layout by optimizing padding around task and list creation drop-zones
Fixed global theme consistency issues including pop-up modal styling, invisible placeholders, and dark-theme text overlaps
Made the Navigation Logo theme-aware and unified Aurora Gradient visuals across all application pages
Resolved an issue preventing the Task Card Title from validating properly upon creation

title: Genesis — Task Management Platform Release
changes: Kanban Board System with full CRUD for boards, lists, and task cards with real-time Firestore synchronization
Drag-and-drop card movement between lists with optimistic UI updates and rollback on failure
Smart Priority Engine with automatic prioritization based on due dates, effort, complexity, and dependency analysis
AI Co-Pilot powered by Google Gemini for task summarization, standup generation, workload analysis, and natural language task creation
Task Submission & Review Workflow with pending, approved, and rejected states, reviewer assignment, and QA checklists
Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) with 35+ granular permissions across business, boards, lists, cards, OCR, and AI features
Business Management with organization creation, member invitations (email-based), role assignment with level hierarchy and capacity limits
In-App Notification System with deduplication, 100-notification cap, and real-time delivery for task assignments, reviews, and submissions
Business Analytics Dashboard with project health scoring, risk distribution analysis, review bottleneck detection, and workload balancing insights
36+ Theme System with full CSS variable architecture supporting light, dark, and gradient themes (Olive, Barbie, Cyberpunk, Dracula, Aurora, and more)
User Presence Detection via Firebase Realtime Database for online/offline member status tracking
OCR Integration for importing task data from scanned documents and images
Board Calendar View for timeline-based task visualization with due date tracking
Personal & Business Dashboards with separate workspace modes and dedicated info pages
Firebase Authentication with email/password signup, email verification, and consent tracking (Terms & Privacy)
Today's Tasks aggregation across all boards with overdue and start-date awareness
Card Details Modal with subtasks, progress tracking, weight scoring, labels, and assignee management
Task Card Features including priority labels, effort estimation, start/end dates, dependencies, and workflow stages
Optimistic Snapshots with automatic rollback for a seamless, lag-free user experience
Responsive Landing Page with animated hero sections, dual Business/Personal mode toggle, and interactive Kanban preview
Stripe Integration for premium pricing with payment success handling
Docker & Vercel deployment configuration with Nginx reverse proxy support
Firestore Security Rules with comprehensive read/write access control for all collections
